title: Verify mastery: Apply an operator emergency stop across the fleet
goal: VC-201-080 (P0) claims mastery of: Persist and distribute a scoped stop that rejects new work and cancels eligible running tasks even after restart; status identifies unreachable peers and external actions that cannot be recalled.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: the operator emergency stop persists across restart, rejects new work and cancels eligible running tasks. Verified by `crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_080.rs`: persists_across_restart, stop_rejects_new_work_and_cancels_eligible. Residual: status reporting of unreachable peers and of external actions that cannot be recalled is not enumerated by a named check. Evidence: T-CLAUDE-143.. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_080_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
